notes.title: House of Jigsaw NEW DLC Release Announcement
notes.notes:
🚀🎮 [b]Exciting DLC Release Announcement! [/b]

Get ready for an electrifying new adventure in your favorite free to play game! We're happy to announce the release of our new DLC, arriving next Wednesday, November 1st. Add this DLC to your wishlist now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649590/House_of_Jigsaw_Digital_Art_Manipulation/

Immerse yourself in the boundless world of digital art manipulation in House of Jigsaw: Digital Art Manipulation DLC. Unleash your inner artist, sharpen your visual acumen, and embrace the wonders of digital artistry with the enigmas of the House. Will you emerge as a triumphant creator, or will you become another enigma in the House's twisted legacy?

[i]🕰️ Save the Date: November 1st, 2023[/i]
